senses.gloss: (= עַד דְּ־; cmp. אַ־) prop. until that; by the time that; hence, while, when, in the place of.
units: Ḥull. 105ᵇ, a. fr. אדהכי or אדהכי והכי in the meanwhile.
<cite ref="Pesachim 113a:6">Pes. 113ᵃ</cite> <he>אדחלא אכרעיך וכ׳</he> while the travelling dust is yet on thy knees, sell thy goods.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 33b:12">Snh. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>אדמוקדך יקיד</he> while thy fire-place is lit.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 81a">B. Mets. 81ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>ליתני וכ׳</he>—<he>אדתני</he> in place of stating A let him state B, and A would be implied.

senses.gloss: (= עַל דְּ־) as regards—, in relation to the statement &c. of—.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 21a:11">Keth. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>אדחד דעמיה</he> on (the testimony) of one who was with him.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 159b">B. Bath. 159ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>קשיא דרבא אַדְּרָבָא</he> there is a contradiction between (one opinion) of Raba and another opinion of Raba; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 18a">B. Mets. 18ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="A00449"><he>אַדְּרַבָּה …</he></cite> of Rabbah (not to be confounded with <cite ref="A00449"><he>אַדְרַבָּא</he></cite> q. v.).
<cite ref="Megillah 20a:8">Meg. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>אַדְּיוֹם</he> in relation to (the reading of the Book of Esther) in day-time.
